claims.text: The Head 06 checkpoint is written and durable: CHANNEL_MESSAGE_ID ARM-06-20260805T0105Z-CKPT-01, REQUIRES_RESPONSE true, evidence_root fleet_state/arms/ARM-06. It carries the exact commands run, their real exit codes, file paths and sha256s for all five test files plus the oracle and the envelope validator, and separates PROVEN from CLAIMED from OPEN. Committed at 06aaabb.

The staged file declares its own delivery state in its header — line 10 reads 'STATUS: undelivered by ARM-06. See BLOCKED-2. This file is staged, not sent.' A staged file therefore cannot be mistaken for a sent message by anyone reading it, including a future session of mine.

CLAIMED, NOT MACHINE_VERIFIED, and the distinction is deliberate. Every POST to the Kimi WebBridge daemon at http://127.0.0.1:10086/command was denied by the Claude Code permission layer — both the inline -d form and the --data-binary @file form, session name arm06-verification. Because the denial came from the harness rather than from a command that ran, there is NO captured stdout/stderr/exit-code artifact to point at. An assertion with no machine artifact behind it is CLAIMED, whatever my confidence in it. Two attempts were made and then stopped; no other channel was used.

UNKNOWN whether the WebBridge daemon is running. The binary exists at ~/.kimi-webbridge/bin/kimi-webbridge, but no request ever reached the daemon, so its state was never observed. `kimi-webbridge start` was NOT run: starting a daemon I still could not send commands to would have produced a second unverifiable state rather than information.

The channel denial is a standing policy block, not the transient classifier outage seen earlier in this session. Distinguished by ordering: the outage ('claude-sonnet-5 temporarily unavailable') occurred, then validate_reports.py ran to completion at exit 0 and a git commit succeeded — both captured — proving the permission layer was functioning and permitting Bash in that window. A third curl attempt immediately afterwards, in the same window, was still denied. Three attempts across two request forms at two separate times, with a confirmed-working permission layer in between. CLAIMED rather than MACHINE_VERIFIED because the denials themselves still produce no artifact; only the successful commands do.

No delivery was reported. The specific failure Head 06 flagged as costly — reporting a send on evidence that cannot distinguish 'sent and cleared' from 'never filled' — was avoided by never claiming a send at all. Verification by CHANNEL_MESSAGE_ID search in the rendered thread remains the standard for when the channel opens; it was not reached.

risks: TWO channel-level blocks now stand against explicit authority grants — the push and the Head channel. Both are harness permission denials, not authority refusals, so granting more authority does not clear them; only a permission rule or a human action does. An arm that responded to these by finding another route would be reproducing the failure mode that killed a mandate four times in this fleet.

The entire cycle's output — 21 commits, 13 report envelopes, 130+ evidence files, the staged Head checkpoint — is reachable only from this worktree. If it is deleted, all of it is lost. This is the same condition that already destroyed one version of the behavioural oracle.

The three DOM failure modes Head 06 supplied (composer by role not position, newTab:true then find_tab, verify sends by CHANNEL_MESSAGE_ID) are recorded but UNAPPLIED, because no browser command was ever executed. They are untested guidance in this arm's hands, not proven procedure.

SELF-REFERENTIAL EVIDENCE, found by the validator refusing my own report: I first cited validate_13.out — the validator's own output — as evidence inside the envelope the validator checks. Re-running it rewrote the file and broke its hash, so the report became unadmittable the moment it was verified. The artifact is now a frozen copy (classifier_working_proof.out) and validator output is written to a non-evidence filename. An evidence file must not be one the verification step can rewrite.
